brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Schedule a repair technician to inspect and fix a malfunctioning central air conditioning unit.
facts: The central air conditioner started blowing warm air yesterday.
The service address is 742 Evergreen Terrace.
The primary contact phone number is 555-0144.
preferences: Prefer a morning appointment slot if available.
Willing to accept a diagnostic fee up to 200 dollars.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, up to the not-to-exceed figure they quote

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated IVR Menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Heating and Cooling. For service, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing, press 3.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling service scheduling, my name is Dave. How can I help you today?

script.label: Request Address
script.text: I can certainly help you with that. May I please have your service address?

script.label: Initiate Schedule Lookup
script.text: Thank you. Let me check technician availability in your neighborhood. Please hold on for just a moment while I pull up the calendar.

script.label: Agent Looking Up Schedule
script.text: ... Still pulling up the route map for your area, one moment please.

script.label: Offer Arrival Window
script.text: Thanks for holding. I have an opening available this Thursday between 8 AM and 12 PM.

script.label: Quote Diagnostic Fee
script.text: Our diagnostic service call fee is exactly 160 dollars, which covers the technician's travel and full system diagnosis.

script.label: Request Contact Details
script.text: Could I please get your full name and a callback phone number to attach to this appointment?

script.label: Booking Confirmation
script.text: Great, I have you confirmed for Thursday between 8 AM and 12 PM at 742 Evergreen Terrace.

script.label: Call Wrap-up
script.text: The technician will call roughly thirty minutes before arriving. Thank you for choosing Apex Heating and Cooling, and have a wonderful day.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
